query_contrast.mapping_rule: vial_name must map exactly to one nonblank quantification column after stripping Peak area and run suffix
query_contrast.missing_metadata_sample_policy: exclude before effect estimation; do not infer treatment from abundance

candidate_study: MSV000084775 IBD200 reprocessing already consumed in the primary pediatric IBD query
negative_label_policy: all non-target contrasts are real alternatives, not asserted biological negatives
primary_gate: exact_positive must be the unique rank 1 in the all-entity world
unknown_increment_gate: primary gate passes, unresolved-only exact_positive is unique rank 1, and the all-world target-over-best-competitor margin is strictly larger than the known-only margin

feature_qc.transform: robust CLR per sample over positive values; zeros remain zero

response_score: weighted cosine of tanh(beta/(2*study median_abs_beta))*abs(beta/SE)/(1+abs(beta/SE)); pair weights are WSE squared

independence_gate.failure_policy: abort if any exact query vial_name occurs in any candidate metadata field

claim_boundary: A primary PASS is a real independent-cohort positive control on development data, not final external validation. The publication and prior pediatric result motivated the treatment hypothesis. A FAIL is frozen without retuning. Unknown-entity value is adjudicated separately from overall response retrieval.
